🎬How to Film It
Where to use it one stick → 7 places
Hook
"You're only using your stick balm on your face?"Hold the stick up to the camera. Put "7 places to use your stick balm" on screen.
Problem
"Dry spots show up everywhere this time of year."Cut to a dry spot up close: flaky lips, rough elbow or heel. Bare skin, no filter.
Solution
"So it goes everywhere."Go through the places in order, one cut each, name on screen:
  1. Under eyes and smile lines, the balm melts right in
  2. Lips and cuticles, for the flaky bits
  3. Neck & chest, for a glow
  4. Elbows and heels, the ones nobody expects
Proof
"Look at that."Run your finger over a spot you just did. Turn it to the light so the glow shows.
Close
⭐ Hold the stick up. "One stick, head to toe. It lives in my bag now."

Title on screen first, one cut per place with the name on screen, end on the stick in your hand

✅Filming Rules
  • Put "7 places to use your stick balm" on screen at the start.
  • Name each spot on screen as you go.
  • Twist it up and swipe, close to the camera.
  • Include elbows and heels.
  • Bare skin, no filter.
  • Hands in frame for every spot.
  • 20 seconds or longer.
  • Post the last week of October.
